{
  "claims": [
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:36037",
      "quote": "the draft model predicts likely verification outcomes and pre-speculates tokens for those outcomes in advance",
      "claim": "The feature request describes asynchronous speculation.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "A prepared branch helps only when its predicted outcome matches verification.",
      "reported_result": "The issue repeats a paper claim of up to 2× speedup over optimized speculative decoding; it reports no vLLM measurement.",
      "transfer_inference": "DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash could benefit if drafting latency is material and likely outcomes can be predicted affordably.",
      "limitations": "B200 performance, prediction accuracy, draft cost, and any measured vLLM bottleneck are unknown. The issue is closed as not planned; the supplied text gives no technical reason."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "fulltext:2603.03251",
      "quote": "If the actual verification outcome is in the predicted set, a speculation can be returned immediately",
      "claim": "The paper states the conditional latency benefit of preparing branches during verification.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "The actual outcome must be among the prepared branches.",
      "reported_result": "The authors claim Saguaro is on average 30% faster than their strongest speculative decoding baselines.",
      "transfer_inference": "The mechanism could apply if verification and branch preparation can overlap in the target serving configuration.",
      "limitations": "The supplied excerpt omits experiment configurations and implementation details. B200 results, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash results, resource quantities, and target effect size are unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "fulltext:2603.03251",
      "quote": "scaling the number of draft devices and thus the speculation cache",
      "claim": "The authors identify additional draft devices and a larger speculation cache as latency-related resource costs.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "The authors say returns from adding draft devices eventually diminish.",
      "reported_result": "The excerpt provides no device count, cache size, or cost for this transfer.",
      "transfer_inference": "A B200 evaluation should account for additional draft compute, cache memory, and hardware.",
      "limitations": "The quantities required for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash are unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "fulltext:2603.03251",
      "quote": "generally ineffective for throughput-bound workloads",
      "claim": "The authors caution that speculative decoding adds verification work to compute-bound serving.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "Their caution concerns throughput-bound workloads such as large-scale RL and offline data generation.",
      "reported_result": "The authors also claim a better latency-throughput frontier for SSD after accounting for additional hardware; the excerpt supplies no supporting measurements.",
      "transfer_inference": "A throughput-bound DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash deployment may have less to gain than a latency-bound one.",
      "limitations": "The target workload and whether it is throughput-bound are unknown. No measured vLLM bottleneck is supplied."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:62541",
      "quote": "Full sweep [run 38438383633](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/38438383633) passed all 17 points and both evals",
      "claim": "The PR author reports validation of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash B200 recipe settings.",
      "relation": "context",
      "conditions": "Settings vary by DEP configuration and concurrency; the PR changes guide text only.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports 17 passing sweep points and two evaluations.",
      "transfer_inference": "The documented configurations offer candidate baselines for a B200 comparison.",
      "limitations": "The PR reports no asynchronous speculation implementation, measured bottleneck, or SSD speedup. The relevant target workload and effect size remain unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:49620",
      "quote": "This PR discards stale asynchronous output after every preemption.",
      "claim": "The open PR describes a correctness hazard from asynchronous speculative output arriving after preemption.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "The proposed handling counts each speculative frame as `1 + num_scheduled_spec` placeholder tokens and preserves the discard budget across repeated preemptions.",
      "reported_result": "The source lists planned regressions and a test command, but no completed test result.",
      "transfer_inference": "An SSD integration needs explicit invalidation of in-flight output and KV-state accounting through preemption and prefix-cache reset.",
      "limitations": "This proposed fix does not establish that the path is implemented or validated for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on B200."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:30980",
      "quote": "**mean TPOT: 268.02 ms -> 260.72 = 2.7% speedup**",
      "claim": "A separate vLLM asynchronous DP-coordination PR reports a TPOT improvement.",
      "relation": "context",
      "conditions": "The reported benchmark uses DeepSeek-R1 with MTP, DP8, expert parallelism, and 2048 maximum request concurrency. The PR is closed and unmerged.",
      "reported_result": "The PR reports mean TPOT falling by 7.30 ms; its tables show mean TTFT rising from 20707.70 to 24249.12 ms.",
      "transfer_inference": "This shows a possible overlap benefit in a different asynchronous mechanism, but does not establish an SSD benefit for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.",
      "limitations": "Hardware is unknown. The model, workload, and mechanism differ; the result measures DP coordination."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:62073",
      "quote": "`max_num_seqs × (1 + num_speculative_tokens)` tokens per sequence-parallel rank",
      "claim": "A separate open PR specifies a decode workspace whose capacity grows with speculative token count.",
      "relation": "context",
      "conditions": "The formula applies to the PR's FlashInfer MegaMoE path. Its throughput benchmark is Beam prefill on GB300.",
      "reported_result": "The PR reports 168.8K versus 98.7K input tokens/s for Beam prefill, unrelated to SSD.",
      "transfer_inference": "A B200 experiment should measure any workspace allocation and warmup costs in its actual serving path.",
      "limitations": "This formula does not quantify SSD branch-cache cost or any DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash effect."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "arxiv:2410.17375",
      "quote": "both models to perform predictions independently on separate devices",
      "claim": "The AMUSD abstract proposes asynchronous drafting and verification on separate devices.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "Its design assumes independently running draft and verify models.",
      "reported_result": "The abstract claims an average 29% improvement over speculative decoding and identical output quality.",
      "transfer_inference": "Separate devices are one possible way to overlap work in the target deployment.",
      "limitations": "This abstract is not implementation evidence. Hardware, workload, resource cost, correctness method, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash effect are unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "arxiv:2506.11309",
      "quote": "KV-cache inconsistencies, and communication overheads",
      "claim": "The SwiftSpec abstract identifies KV-cache correctness and communication obstacles.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "Its stated setting is small-batch, tensor-parallel, low-latency decoding.",
      "reported_result": "The abstract claims an average 1.75× speedup across five model families and six datasets and cites a Llama3-70B result on eight Hopper GPUs.",
      "transfer_inference": "A B200 transfer should check KV consistency and communication cost under the actual parallelism and batch sizes.",
      "limitations": "This abstract is not implementation evidence and supplies no DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash or B200 result."
    }
  ],
  "unanswered": [
    "What are the measured draft, verification, synchronization, and idle times for the intended DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash B200 vLLM workload?",
    "What fraction of actual verification outcomes would affordable prepared branches cover?",
    "How much extra compute, cache and workspace memory, communication, and hardware would SSD require at the intended concurrency?",
    "Would an implementation preserve exact output behavior through branch selection, preemption, prefix-cache reset, and multiple in-flight frames?",
    "What are the end-to-end latency and throughput effects against the documented B200 recipe under the intended workload?"
  ]
}
